hints.tr: `transform("mean")` her satıra kendi grubunun ortalamasını yazıyor; sonuç `t` ile aynı uzunlukta.
hints.en: `transform("mean")` writes the mean of its group on every row; the result is as long as `t`.

hints.tr: `pacf(anomaly, nlags=5)` de gecikme 0 ile başlıyor; `[1:]` ile at.
hints.en: `pacf(anomaly, nlags=5)` also starts with lag 0; drop it with `[1:]`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import acf, pacf

t = pd.read_csv("temperature_daily.csv", index_col="date", parse_dates=True)
t = t["temp_c"]

normal = t.groupby(t.index.dayofyear).transform("mean")
anomaly = t - normal

a = acf(anomaly, nlags=5)
print([round(float(v), 2) for v in a[1:]])

pa = pacf(anomaly, nlags=5)
print([round(float(v), 2) for v in pa[1:]])

r = float(a[1])
print([round(r ** power, 2) for power in range(1, 6)])

raw = acf(t, nlags=365)
print(round(float(raw[1]), 2), round(float(raw[365]), 2))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import acf, pacf

t = pd.read_csv("temperature_daily.csv", index_col="date", parse_dates=True)
t = t["temp_c"]

normal = t.groupby(t.index.dayofyear).transform("mean")
anomaly = t - normal

a = acf(anomaly, nlags=5)
print([round(float(v), 2) for v in a[1:]])

pa = pacf(anomaly, nlags=5)
print([round(float(v), 2) for v in pa[1:]])

r = float(a[1])
print([round(r ** power, 2) for power in range(1, 6)])

raw = acf(t, nlags=365)
print(round(float(raw[1]), 2), round(float(raw[365]), 2))
```
